name: Collecting the head of the Werewolf

msg: You have killed the beast that was causing the villagers so much trouble. Now all that is left is to collect its head as proof.

eventDo: You kneel down and cut off the head of the werewolf. It is a gruesome task, but you know that you need to bring it back as proof.
You decide that you need to come back later. You have other things to do.
